children: The headline inflation rate in Canada was unchanged from the previous month at 3.0% in August of 2026, aligned with market expectations and remaining below the post-Iran-war peak of 3.2%.
Price growth remained dominated by energy goods as the war in the Middle East halted a key source of global oil supply.
Gasoline inflation stood at 22.8% in the month, slowing slightly from the 25.7% increase in the previous month.
Conversely, groceries prices rose 2.8% from the 3.1% increase in July, falling below the headline inflation rate for the first time in over two years.
Core inflation rates that are tracked by the Bank of Canada remained close to their target.
The trimmed-mean core rate and the median core rate were both unchanged at 1.9% and 2%, respectively, aligned with expectations.
From the previous month, the Canadian CPI inched down by 0.1%.

title: Canadian Inflation Holds at 3%
